title: 莲花资管How Hall：政策信号不足，中国主要指数或再跌15%
speaker: How Hall

segments.en: Is it still the earnings side of things, the monetization of the AI?
segments.zh: 还是盈利端的问题吗？AI的商业化？

segments.en: Well, firstly, I think the general environment has to improve.
segments.zh: 首先，我认为整体环境必须改善。

segments.en: Right, so right now, you know, we're not seeing, for example, the traditional policy stimulus, right?
segments.zh: 对，目前我们没看到传统的政策刺激，对吧？

segments.en: Normally, you know, when, when, when things is dispatched, you see, you know, policy stimulus coming out, like in growth and, you know, trying to drive up the market.
segments.zh: 通常，当事情发生时，你会看到政策刺激出台，比如促进增长、试图推动市场。

segments.en: But now, you know, you see Hong Kong and Asia, the Shanghai market, it's falling down like many, many of the critical levels, right?
segments.zh: 但现在，你看香港和亚洲、内地市场，正跌破许多关键水平，对吧？

segments.en: So, you know, at times, we thought that, you know, 3500 is going to hold, right?
segments.zh: 所以，有时我们以为3500点会守住，对吧？

segments.en: Yesterday, it sort of penetrated down. So, you know, we're seeing, we're not seeing regulates making sort of a very strong both move on the market and also on the economy.
segments.zh: 昨天它跌破了。所以，我们看到监管层没有在市场和经济上采取非常有力的双重举措。

segments.en: And I think, secondly, yes, you're right. You know, just now, we said that earnings estimate hasn't come down yet, right?
segments.zh: 其次，你说得对。刚才我们说盈利预期还没下调，对吧？

segments.en: So it's way too optimistic for the next year.
segments.zh: 所以对明年来说太乐观了。

segments.en: And therefore, it has to come down first, you know, before we get, like, really positive on this.
segments.zh: 因此，它必须先下调，然后我们才能真正乐观起来。

segments.en: How much more downside are you for seeing? For, for, for, for which market? For, for Chinese, for Chinese market, yeah.
segments.zh: 您认为还有多少下行空间？哪个市场？中国市场，好的。

segments.en: Well, I think, you know, we should see another 15 or more percent down, you know, on the major indices.
segments.zh: 我认为主要指数可能还有15%或更多的下行空间。
